description: This file defines the Store class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class provides methods to retrieve store information from the database, including specific store data by ID, by hostname, and all stores. It serves as a model component in the application's MVC architecture.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching store details from the database, supporting retrieval by store ID, hostname, or fetching all stores with caching.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves store details based on the provided store ID. Returns default store info if ID is 0, otherwise queries the database for specific store data.

methods.name: getStoreByHostname
methods.description: Retrieves store information based on the provided hostname URL, replacing 'www.' for uniformity.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store records from the database, caching the results for efficiency.
